name: Palak Bajpai
place: Jabrella, Bharsaua and two further campuses
deck: Four dense little forests inside school and college gates: 1,025 plants across 2,120 square feet, put in on four dated days in 2026. Another 435 saplings are still held back for the next site.
description: Four dense forests on school and college ground, 1,025 plants across 2,120 square feet, planted on four days, with 435 held back for the next one.

aims.h: A forest inside a school gate
aims.p: None of the four plots is large — four hundred square feet at Jabrella, a thousand at The Good Harvest School. Miyawaki planting is what fits ground that size.

aims.h: Buy for the next site as well
aims.p: Fourteen hundred and sixty plants procured, one thousand and twenty-five in the ground, four hundred and thirty-five held back rather than crowded in.
Two primary schools, a school and a college. The four plots sit where children and students walk past them every day of term.

aims.h: Plant when the labour is there
aims.p: The four days fell in February and March 2026, outside the window the Forest Department and the nurseries recommend. The wheat harvest had the labour until then.

did: Planted 200 plants across 400 sq ft at Primary School, Jabrella, on 14 February 2026
Planted 150 across 350 sq ft at Basic Vidyalaya, Bharsaua, on 21 February 2026
Planted 500 across 1,000 sq ft at The Good Harvest School on 21 March 2026
Planted 175 across 370 sq ft at Pt. Lalita Prasad Ramkisha Mahavidyalaya on 30 March 2026
Ran it as a four-person team — Palak holds the fellowship, with Nisha on labour and materials, Roli on sourcing and plantation, Kshama on plant knowledge and outreach
Reached about a thousand more people through Instagram and WhatsApp
Held back 435 of the 1,460 plants procured for continued planting
